comment: The latency bars the project claims, and the benches that measure them.
Every read the server serves answers in under a millisecond, a page of an
expansion included (the owner's bar, 2026-09-05, tightened from the ten
milliseconds #129 set for a page); scripts/checks/bench-bars.sh runs the
benches and fails when a median crosses its bar.
A bar is the CLAIM, not a machine's measurement: it never moves to match
a slower run. `measured_ms` records what one machine answered, so the
headroom a run has is visible, and it is a record, never a gate.
machine: Apple M2 Pro, macOS 25.5, release profile, 20000 synthetic concepts
